At 6th level, you have learned how to deepen your pact with the warlock you once met. You may choose to take double the necrotic damage you rolled on your Bardic Inspiration die to instead have the effect last for 1 hour.

At 14th level, your pact with the warlock unlocks frightening new power. When you reach 14th level, choose a single spell of 7th level or lower from the {@filter warlock's spell list|spells|level=0;1;2;3;4;5;6;7|class=warlock}. You may cast the spell once during this effect without expending any spell slots, although you must cast it at the level of your highest spell slot. In exchange, the spell deals additional necrotic damage to you equal to twice the level at which it was cast.

name: Dark Malediction (Passive)
entries: Interdicted creatures radiate darkness in a 10-foot radius. Mundane sources of light can't illuminate this darkness, but creatures with {@sense darkvision} can see through it. If any of this darkness overlaps with an area of light created by magic or psionics, the overlapping area of darkness is illuminated by the light.

name: Darkvision (CM)
entries: {@b Cost:} {@i 1 Mutation Point}
You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.

name: Darkvision

prerequisite.other: Beetles, mosquitoes, cockroaches, or any nocturnal insect

entries: The swarm has darkvision out to a range of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
entries: A life spent in shadow has made you grow accustomed to the gloom. You can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. You can't discern color in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Improved Darkvision
entries: If you take this trait twice, the range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 120 feet.

name: Deadly Bite
entries: When the wildcat hits a {@condition prone} creature with a Bite attack, the attack is a critical hit.

name: Debilitating Magic

prerequisite.other: Stage 1 of the {@charoption Shadowsteel Ghoul|GrimHollowPG24|Shadowsteel Ghoul Transformation}

entries: Choose one ability score. You lose 2 points in that ability as the power of the Shadowsteel slowly eats away at your body, soul, or both.

name: Decapitating Strike
entries: When the bird scores a critical hit against a Tiny target, the target is decapitated. A decapitated target dies if they can't survive without that head.

name: Delicacy
entries: As an action, you can spend 1 wick point to imbue the tart flavor of a {@item Pyramid Melon|ObojimaTallGrass} and the healing properties of a river spirit into your candle. As a bonus action, a creature can consume the candle, causing it to regain {@dice 1d6} hit points and providing enough nourishment to sustain it for one day. A candle holds this enchantment for 24 hours, after which the properties of {@i delicacy} fade. You can have no more than 2 candles with this enchantment at a time.

name: Demon
entries: While wearing this mask you gain the abilities Arcane Memory and Demon Eye.

items.name: Arcane Memory
entries: While wearing this mask, you can use an action and expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to magically learn whether a creature or object you specify has been within a 20-foot radius of your current location in the past 24 hours. If you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you get a brief vision of the creature or object while it was there, and you learn the exact time the creature or object was present.

items.name: Demon Eye
entries: As an action, you gain the ability to magically see through solid objects to a range of 15 feet. Your vision penetrates most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Desert Dweller
entries: The wildcat ignores difficult terrain created by dirt and sand. They can tolerate temperatures as high as 120° Fahrenheit, and they don't need to drink water as long as they have fresh food.

name: Detonate
entries: As an action, you can spend 3 wick points to ignite and throw a dark black candle at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. A brilliant eruption of flame sweeps out from the candle, causing each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point to make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage and {@damage 2d8} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When you use this enchantment, you can spend additional wick points to increase the fire damage dealt by {@dice 1d6} for each additional wick point spent.
The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

name: Devil
entries: This obsidian mask bears the fangs and horns of a handsome fiend. When you take damage from a creature that is within 30 feet of yourself, you can expend a use of your {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal Fire damage to the creature. This damage equals two rolls of your {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} die, and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt.

name: Devilish Contractor
entries: You have acquired the ability to bind mortal creatures to your will. You can create a contract to bind a mortal Humanoid's soul to you, feeding on its power. The mortal gains a gift asked for in the contract, and you gain a Gift of Damnation of your choice (see Gifts of Damnation).
To bind a mortal's soul to you, you must first create a contract for their desired gift. A contract requires magical ink and paper worth 10 GP for each Transformation Stage you have acquired.

You and the mortal must both sign the contract willingly, fully aware of the costs involved. Once signed, daemonic entities give you a Gift of Damnation, and the mortal receives their desired wishes within 7 days. You do not have to provide this boon yourself.

For example, upon signing a contract for a {@optfeature Gift of Unfettered Glory|GrimHollowPG24}, you receive the benefits listed for that gift. The mortal who signs receives their stated desire, provided by the dubious powers of the Netherworld. You cannot benefit directly from the mortal's desired gift, nor can an ally. No ally of yours can ever sign a contract with you.
You may take a Gift of Damnation of the Stage that you have attained or lower. For example, if you are at Stage 2 of the Transformation, you may only take a Stage 1 or Stage 2 Gift of Damnation.

There is no limit to the number of contracts you can execute, but you can only have one active Gift of Damnation at a time. When you would gain a second Gift of Damnation, you may replace your active gift with the new one. Also, when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} you may swap your active Gift of Damnation for any other gift associated with a signed contract.

name: Devilish Subcontractor
entries: You may gain the benefits of two Gifts of Damnation at the same time. You may still only switch one Gift of Damnation after a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Dis's Onslaught (Passive)
entries: Each time you use a bonus action to place or move a seal, you can make one weapon attack as part of the same bonus action.

name: Disarming Swipe
entries: You can target your foe's weapon instead of their body. When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 2 maneuver points and deal no damage with that attack. Instead, the target must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or be disarmed. A disarmed creature drops any weapons or shields it is holding.

name: Disease Carrier
entries: When the swarm hits a creature with an attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} (save ends at end of turn).

name: Dispater's Supremacy (Passive)
entries: Your attacks against interdicted creatures score a critical hit on a roll of 18 through 20.

name: Disquieting Voice
entries: {@b Cost:} {@i 1 Mutation Point}
You can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the {@action Influence|XPHB} action's skill options with them.

name: Divine Clemency
entries: When an ally within 30 feet of you that you can see takes damage, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cast {@spell Healing Word|XPHB} at first level on that ally without using a spell slot.
You can do this a number of times equal to your Transformation Stage. You regain all uses of this feature after finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Divine Sangromancy
entries: A connection to the life force of others lets you shape that force to their benefit. Whenever an allied creature within 30 feet of you regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can spend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} and add the roll of the die to the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} gained by the ally.

entries.name: Sangromancy Savant
entries: If you take this trait twice, when you use Divine Sangromancy, you also regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} roll.

name: Dodge Roll
entries: You can expend one {@classFeature Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move up to 15 feet and reload any Ranged weapon you are holding. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and is unaffected by {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

name: Dragon
entries: You add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to Intelligence and Wisdom checks you make that relate to the Dragon creature type. If you are already proficient in a skill when asked to make an Intelligence or Wisdom ability check relating to Dragons, you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} instead.
When you gain this feature, you also learn {@language Draconic}.

name: Dragon
entries: When you put on this mask, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns while you wear it, you can expend a {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} die to exhale flames in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes Fire damage equal to two rolls of your {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} die, or half as much damage on a successful save.

name: Draining Attack
entries: As your enemy's life force ebbs, you grow ever stronger. If you have the {@optfeature Natural Attack|GrimHollowPG24} trait, each time you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt by the attack.

entries.name: To the Dregs
entries: If you take this trait twice, when you use Draining Attack, the target also takes a penalty to their {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum equal to the damage dealt by the attack. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Draining Flight

prerequisite.other: Stage 3 of the {@charoption Specter|GrimHollowPG24|Specter Transformation}, {@optfeature Incorporeal Movement|GrimHollowPG24} & {@optfeature Haunting Flight|GrimHollowPG24}

entries: You can now use your {@optfeature Incorporeal Movement|GrimHollowPG24} feature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} while using {@optfeature Haunting Flight|GrimHollowPG24} becomes double your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

Additionally, while you are using {@optfeature Incorporeal Movement|GrimHollowPG24}, your movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and you can damage creatures that you move through. Once per turn, when you enter a space occupied by a creature, you can choose to force that creature to succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 6d6} Psychic damage and have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. A creature takes half damage on a successful save and is not {@condition Frightened|XPHB}. The DC of the Constitution saving throw is 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage.
Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

name: Draught of Bear's Endurance
entries: For 10 minutes, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws.

name: Draught of Bull's Strength
entries: For 10 minutes, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

name: Draught of Cat's Grace
entries: For 10 minutes, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws.

name: Draught of Eagle's Splendor
entries: For 10 minutes, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks and Charisma saving throws.

name: Draught of Fox's Cunning
entries: For 10 minutes, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws.

name: Draught of Owl's Wisdom
entries: For 10 minutes, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws.

name: Drawn to Darkness
entries: Your body and soul are bound to the cold darkness of the realms of death. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} as your life force is drawn to oblivion.

name: Dread Venom
entries: A foul-smelling blade oil that causes wounds to hemorrhage and refuse healing. Dread Venom can coat one Slashing or Piercing weapon or up to 10 pieces of Slashing or Piercing ammunition. Applying the oil takes 1 minute and the oil lasts 8 hours once applied. When a creature takes damage from the poisoned item, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Dreams and Nightmares
entries: You gain the ability to manipulate the mind of mortal beings. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose a Humanoid you can see within 30 feet of you. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. The DC is 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage.

On a failed saving throw, the creature has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition, as it is stuck in a blissful dream or a terrifying nightmare. The condition lasts for 1 minute. The target can attempt the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage.

You can choose to concentrate on the effect as you would a spell. If you are {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on the effect when the target attempts its saving throw, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.
You can use this ability a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses of this ability when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Dreamwalking
entries: Whenever you rest, you touch the dreams of those around you, seeding their thoughts and memories into your own mind. When you make an ability check to recall lore or knowledge, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Secret Dreams
entries: If you take this trait twice, you gain an instinctive knowledge of the secrets of other creatures while you touch their dreams. Using a {@action Search|XPHB} action, you focus on one creature you can see and make a DC 15 Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check. With a successful check, you learn one secret of the GM's choice known to that creature. The secrets of creatures that don't have a language come to you as vague images and impressions. You regain the use of this feature when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Driver
entries: The roads and waterways of Etharis are often no less dangerous than the open wilderness, and you dedicate yourself to moving others safely on those routes. You have proficiency with {@item Navigator's Tools|XPHB}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks made to drive a vehicle.

entries.name: Remarkable Driver
entries: If you take this trait twice, you can make checks involving driving a vehicle that require an action without having to use your action. You can only get this free use once per round.

name: Druid
entries: You can cast the {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot. When you cast the {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} spell with this talent, you can target yourself only and the maximum {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of the Beast you can transform into equals half your Druid level.
Once you cast the spell using this talent, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Dual Nature
entries: You add a second element to your {@optfeature Elemental Affinity|GrimHollowPG24|Elemental Affinity Boon}. When you do so, you gain the associated benefits of your new element.

name: Durable
entries: The swarm's hit points are doubled, and they have an Armor Class of 15, a +5 bonus to Constitution saving throws, and advantage on Constitution saving throws. (+1 CR)

name: Eager Deceiver
entries: You long ago learned that being open with others only gives them power over you. You have proficiency in the {@skill Deception|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Expert Deceiver
entries: If you take this trait twice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Deception checks. You can use this feature a number of times equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Echolocation
entries: {@b Cost:} {@i 3 Mutation Points}
You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet while you don't have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition.

name: Efficient Killer

prerequisite.other: Stage 2 of the {@charoption Aberrant Horror|GrimHollowPG24|Aberrant Horror Transformation}

entries: When you make an attack with your eldritch limbs, you can gain an added ability based on the damage type you have chosen.

entries.name: Piercing
entries: You may replace any attack made with your eldritch limb with a razor-sharp barb hurled at the target. You are considered proficient with this barb, which has a Range of 20/60, has the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} properties, and deals {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage on a hit.

entries.name: Bludgeoning
entries: You manifest a long tentacle, tipped with a hardened bone club. Your eldritch limb attack deals an additional {@damage 1d8} Bludgeoning damage. Also, the attack uses the {@itemMastery Slow|XPHB} Weapon Property, which you have Mastery with.

entries.name: Slashing
entries: Your arm forms a row of viciously hooked claws and talons. Your eldritch limb attack deals an additional {@damage 1d8} Slashing damage. Also, the attack uses the {@itemMastery Graze|XPHB} Weapon Property, which you have Mastery with.

name: Elastic Limbs
entries: Your limbs have become elastic and tacky, allowing you to reach distant enemies and climb walls.

Your reach increases by 5 feet and you gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. Creatures you are grappling have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks to escape.

name: Eldritch Aberration

prerequisite.other: Stage 4 of the {@charoption Aberrant Horror|GrimHollowPG24|Aberrant Horror Transformation}, Has Spell Slots

entries: You gain the ability to deliver jolts of magical energy with your eldritch limbs. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack using your eldritch limbs, you can expend a spell slot to deal additional damage equal to {@dice 1d6} per spell level expended. You can choose for this additional damage to be of any of the following types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, or Thunder. If any of these extra dice show a 6 when rolled, the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Eldritch Assault
entries: {@b Cost:} {@i 2 Mutation Points}
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls you make with your Wild Shape form's attacks.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this Mutation more than once, but no more than three times.

name: Eldritch Concentration
entries: Your supernatural ability with magic manifests in new ways. When you cast a spell that requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, if you are already {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on one such spell, you can spend the charge of your soul vessel. If you do this, you do not lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on the original spell. Instead, you gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

If you cast a third {@status Concentration|XPHB} spell during this time, or lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} for any other reason, you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on both current spells you are {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on.
Once you use this feature you cannot use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Eldritch Omniscience
entries: You have better mastered the magical arts. The number of spells you can learn and can have prepared increases by 4. Additionally, whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} you gain 1 additional spell slot of whichever level you choose.
If a creature dies as a result of one of your spells, you can instantly draw that soul into your soul vessel without using a {@action Magic|XPHB} action or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

name: Elemental
entries: You add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to Intelligence and Wisdom checks you make that relate to the Elemental creature type. If you are already proficient in a skill when asked to make an Intelligence or Wisdom ability check relating to Elementals, you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} instead.
When you gain this feature, you also learn {@language Primordial}.

name: Elemental Affinity
entries: Though you have sway over all the elements, your Primordial change was sparked by one particular element: your Elemental Affinity. This element infuses your form and dictates your powers. You must choose one element below and gain all the benefits of that element:

items.name: Air
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning damage. In addition, you can channel the air currents around you to guide a ranged attack. Once on each of your turns, when you make an attack with a Ranged weapon or ranged spell, you can make that attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. If you are in a location without air—such as underwater or in a vacuum—this feature has no effect.

items.name: Earth
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning damage. In addition, whenever you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

items.name: Fire
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage. In addition, whenever you deal Fire damage, you can add your Constitution modifier to the damage dealt.

items.name: Water
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 30 feet regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to imbue them with healing elemental energy. The creature regains an additional {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Elemental Ammunition
entries: The head of an arrow or bolt is tipped with poison, loaded with an acid vial, dipped in flammable oil, or coated with another substance. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you imbue with elemental power a single piece of ammunition that can be fired from a {@item Longbow|XPHB}, {@item Shortbow|XPHB}, or Crossbow as part of an {@action Attack|XPHB} action. When an Elemental Ammunition is imbued, choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. When a creature takes damage from the Elemental Ammunition, it takes an additional {@damage 2d6} damage of the chosen type.

Elemental Ammunition discharges its energy if it hits, and it can't be recovered. If the attack misses, the Elemental Ammunition can be recovered and used again. Elemental Ammunition retains its power for 48 hours.

name: Elemental Charge (Armor Modification)
entries: You embed your armor with a Construct's gemstone or infuse it with the power of an Elemental. Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. When you hit a creature with an attack, you can cause it to deal the chosen damage type rather than its normal damage type, and the attack deals an extra {@dice 1d6} of that type.

name: Elemental Imbalance
entries: Your body reacts in strange ways to the application of severe elemental damage. When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1, your Primordial form reacts in a volatile manner, and the following effects occur:

items: You gain {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to the instance of damage you just took, even if you had {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage.
Creatures within 5 feet of you take the original amount of damage that you took. A DC 15 Constitution saving throw halves this damage.

name: Elemental Inurement
entries: {@b Cost:} {@i 2 Mutation Points}
You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one of the following damage types of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this Mutation more than once, but you must choose a different {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} each time.

name: Elemental Mastery
entries: You add the final element to you Elemental Affinity Boon. When you do so, you gain the associated benefits of your new element.

Additionally, you can summon the four elements to wreathe you in power. Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw, dealing {@damage 6d6} damage of a type of your choice from Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, or Lightning, or half as much on a successful save.
After you use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, your Elemental Affinity features gain the following benefits until the end of your next turn

entries.name: Air
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all Ranged weapon and ranged spell attacks.

entries.name: Earth
entries: At the beginning of your turn, you gain 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fire
entries: At the beginning of your turn, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you takes {@damage 2d6} Fire damage.

entries.name: Water
entries: Whenever a creature withing 60 feet that you can see regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by spending {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or through a spell or magical ability, that creature regains an additional 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier, regaining all uses upon completing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Elemental Surge
entries: You can channel pure elemental energy into a concentrated bolt of an element of your choice. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can use any of the following options:

items.name: Lightning Strike
entries: You can make a ranged attack targeting a creature within 60 feet. You are proficient with this attack, which uses your Constitution modifier. On a hit, this attack deals {@dice 3d8} plus your Constitution modifier Lightning damage. You can then use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to target another creature within 30 feet of the first target with the same attack.
Increase the damage of these attacks by {@dice 1d8} for each Transformation Stage above 2.

items.name: Earth Shard
entries: You can force a creature within 30 feet to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 3d6} plus your Constitution modifier, or half as much on a successful save. Increase the damage by {@dice 1d6} for each Transformation Stage above 2.
You also gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage dealt.

items.name: Flame Wave
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw against a DC equal to 8 plus your Constitution modifier plus your Transformation Stage. On a failed save, creatures in the area take Fire damage equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Constitution modifier. Increase the damage by {@dice 1d8} for each Transformation Stage above 2.

items.name: Aquatic Rejuvenation
entries: Choose a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The creature regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Constitution modifier. Increase the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} regained by {@dice 1d8} for each Transformation Stage above 2.

items: You can use Elemental Surge a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Elfsight Oil
entries: For 8 hours, you have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

name: Embrace the Past
entries: The lessons of the past are harsh, but learning those lessons might give you the best insight for navigating the future. You have proficiency in the {@skill History|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Deep Lore
entries: If you take this trait twice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill History|XPHB} checks. You can use this feature a number of times equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Enemy in Motion
entries: A lifetime spent wandering lets you judge when others' movement works to your benefit. When you make an attack roll against a creature or make a saving throw against a creature's attack, spell, or ability, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll or saving throw if that creature moved since the end of your last turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Moving Insight
entries: If you take this trait twice, Enemy in Motion also lets you use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to affect an ally's attack roll or saving throw if your ally is within 30 feet.

name: Engulf
entries: When you manifest your Ooze Form, it lasts for 10 minutes.

While manifesting your Ooze Form, you can envelop your foes in your gooey body. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can try to engulf a creature of your size category or smaller that is within 5 feet of you. The target makes a Strength saving throw, with a DC equal to 10 plus your Strength modifier plus your Transformation Stage. On a failure, the creature is engulfed.

While engulfed, a target has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside of you, and when you move, the engulfed target moves with you. While engulfed, a creature takes {@damage 4d6} Acid damage at the start of each of its turns, is suffocating, has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} is fully digested, leaving no body or nonmagical equipment behind.

name: Enhanced Contract
entries: You may switch between your active Gift of Damnation at the end of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. In addition, when you switch Gifts of Damnation, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 5 times your Transformation Stage.

name: Enlarge
entries: {@b Cost:} {@i 2 Mutation Points}

Your size increases by one category (from Medium to Large, for example). You can spend an additional 2 Mutation Points to increase your size by two categories instead (from Medium to Huge, for example), gaining the benefits of the spell again.
See the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} spell to determine the benefits gained from this ability.

name: Entangling Cord
entries: When taking the attack action, you can choose to replace one of your attacks with an entangling strike. Choose an object that features tendril-like properties (such as a tape measure, game controller, extension cord, rope, or chain). The object can be on your person or within 30 feet of you, provided you can see it.

When you do so, the object springs to life, stretching out towards a creature you can see within 15 feet of it. Make a ranged attack using your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. On a hit, the target is pulled up to 15 feet towards the object.

name: Entropic Abomination

prerequisite.other: Stage 4 of the {@charoption Aberrant Horror|GrimHollowPG24|Aberrant Horror Transformation}

entries: This Flaw replacees the Stage 3 Flaw: Unstable Existence. The very essence of magic and the effect of stress aggravates the unstable nature of your aberrant body. Each time you fail a saving throw, or the first time you become {@condition Bloodied|XPHB} after finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you must roll on the {@table Unstable Form|GrimHollowPG24|Unstable Form table}. If the result is less than your current Unstable Form effect, replace it with the new result.

name: Environmental Awareness
entries: The natural world is a dangerous place, and your connection to specific parts of that world grants you an edge in survival. Choose an environment: arctic, coastal, desert, forest, grassland, hill and mountain, swamp, subterranean, or underwater. While in that environment, whenever you make an ability check to assess structures, monuments, or natural features; to find food or drinkable water; or to track creatures, you are considered to have proficiency in the appropriate skill for the check, and you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the check instead of your normal bonus.

entries.name: Adaptive Awareness
entries: If you take this trait multiple times, you gain its benefit for a new environment each time.

Additionally, when you make an ability check using Environmental Awareness, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Ethereal Fade
entries: Shifting away from the mortal world lets you move through and observe that world unseen. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you fade from the Material Plane into the Ethereal Plane for 1 minute. While you remain in this state, you can't interact with the Material Plane, and effects on the Material Plane can't affect you, including spells and creatures. You can move and hear as normal, and you see everything in shades of gray. When the effect ends, you reappear in the Material Plane in the closest unoccupied space to where you faded from. You can end the effect early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You regain the use of this feature again when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ethereal Focus
entries: If you take this trait twice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} when making Wisdom checks as part of a {@action Search|XPHB} action.

name: Ethereal Phasing
entries: You can cast the {@spell Blink|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot. You can cast the spell using this Boon a number of times equal to your Transformation Stage, and you regain all uses after finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

While you are under the effects of Blink when cast in this way, you also gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage at the start of each of your turns.

name: Even in Sleep
entries: An instinctive sense for danger protects you at all times. While you have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition while asleep, you are aware of your surroundings and can make {@skill Perception|XPHB} checks normally.

entries.name: Sleeping Ward
entries: If you take this trait twice, while you are asleep, you automatically detect the presence of any creature intending harm to you that moves within 30 feet of you. A creature that is simply capable of harming you does not trigger this trait until it has intent to do so. For example, a wild animal might approach you cautiously, then decide to attack only when it realizes you are sleeping.

name: Evil Eye
entries: Your visage is so horrifying that you can cause creatures to drop dead when your gaze falls upon them. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you gaze upon a {@condition Bloodied|XPHB} Beast or Humanoid within 30 feet that can see your true form. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to 14 plus your Charisma modifier. If the target fails the save, it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. On a successful save, the creature takes {@damage 6d8} Psychic damage. You regain the use of this feature when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Evocation Lessons
entries: {@note This is a magical effect.} A venerable wizard shared secrets of evocation magic with you. When you select this option, choose a damage-dealing spell you can cast. You can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration when you cast this spell to change the type of damage it deals to your choice of either acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder (chosen when you cast the spell). Add the number you roll on your Bardic Inspiration die + your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1) to the damage dealt by the spell.
At 6th level you may choose to change the spell you had previously selected with this feature to another spell that you know.
At 14th level you may choose to change the spell you had previously selected with this feature to another spell that you know.

activation.condition: When you cast the selected spell

name: Exiling Strike
entries: {@b Blood Cost:} {@dice 1d10}

You use celestial blood to try to temporarily banish your target to a harmless location in the Celestial Plane. A creature hit by the attack must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished. While banished in this way, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
When you reach Fighter level 18, the target also takes {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage when the attack hits it.

name: Eyes of the Gate
entries: As an action, you can expend one or more seals to attempt to bind your awareness to a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw; they can willingly fail this save. On a failed save, you are bound to the target's awareness for a number of hours equal to the number of seals you expended, or until you use this boon on another creature. For the duration, while the target is within 300 feet of you, you can use an action to see and hear through their senses, gaining the benefit of any special senses the target possesses, and you continue to do so until you use your action to return to your normal senses. While perceiving through the target's senses, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.

Additionally, for the duration, you can place seals, burn them, and use interdict boons as if you were in the creature's space, but doing so makes the creature aware of this bond. An aware creature can use their action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effects of this boon on a success.

name: Eyes of the Night
entries: You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, the range increases by 60 feet.

name: Faceless
entries: Two perfectly round eyeholes stare out of this otherwise featureless porcelain mask. While you wear this mask, you always have the {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} spell prepared. Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require a spell slot. If you do so, the spell's casting time becomes 1 minute for that casting and its duration becomes 8 hours. The spell ends early if you remove this mask.

name: Fade Away
entries: You have learned to avoid notice at all costs, letting you momentarily obscure yourself from observation. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action to conceal yourself without needing to be {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} or behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}. You need not be out of a creature's line of sight to use this ability.

You become visible at the start of your next turn unless you have moved into a position that allows you to use the {@action Hide|XPHB} action normally. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Long Fade
entries: If you take this trait twice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your ability check when you take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action from Fade Away, and you become visible at the end of your next turn instead of the start of your next turn.

name: Failing Lungs
entries: Your lungs have begun to ache and your days are filled with excessive coughing. At times you feel yourself gasping for air, and it's in those moments you've learned to steal another's breath. As an action, you pull your next breath from a creature you can see. The target falls {@condition prone} and can't take reactions until the start of your next turn. Additionally, all of your curse markers are consumed, dealing {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage to the creature for each marker consumed in this way.

Alternatively, you can give your breath to another creature. Whenever a creature you can see makes a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to give it advantage on the saving throw and increase its speed by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Falcon's Glide
entries: When you fall, you can use your reaction and spend 1 maneuver point to slow your fall to 60 feet per round for 1 minute. If you land before this time elapses, you take no falling damage.
In addition, as a bonus action on each of your turns for the duration of this maneuver, you can spend 1 additional maneuver point to gain a fly speed of 30 feet until the end of the turn.

name: Fanged Bite
entries: As an {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make a Bite attack. You are considered proficient with this attack, and you can use Strength or Dexterity as the ability. This attack deals Piercing damage equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier. This Bite attack is not a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

If the attack hits a creature that has blood, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take an additional {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage. You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt this way. The DC is 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage.

name: Feral Fighting
entries: You can use a bonus action and spend 1 maneuver point to fight with beastlike fury. When you do, make a single unarmed strike against a creature. On a hit, you can roll {@dice 1d8} in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike.

name: Feral Transformation
entries: As an action, you can transform into a {@creature dire wolf}, {@creature giant spider}, or {@creature giant octopus} following the same rules as the {@spell polymorph} spell, but you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature, as well as any skill proficiencies that your beast form is physically capable of performing. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus instead of yours. You maintain the ability to speak and can cast spells that have only a verbal component.

You maintain this form for 1 hour or until the form drops to 0 hit points, at which point you revert back to your normal form. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form.
Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Fey
entries: You add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to Intelligence and Wisdom checks you make that relate to the Fey creature type. If you are already proficient in a skill when asked to make an Intelligence or Wisdom ability check relating to Fey, you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} instead.
When you gain this feature, you also learn {@language Sylvan}.

name: Fey Form
entries: Your creature type becomes Fey in addition to any other creature type(s) you have.

Also, after you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, pick a damage type from the following list: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Psychic, or Thunder. You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Fiend
entries: You add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to Intelligence and Wisdom checks you make that relate to the Fiend creature type. If you are already proficient in a skill when asked to make an Intelligence or Wisdom ability check relating to Fiends, you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} instead.
When you gain this feature, you also learn {@language Abyssal} or {@language Infernal}.

name: Fiend Bound
entries: Your body and soul are bound to the Netherworld. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} as the plane attempts to pull you into it.

name: Fiend Form
entries: Your appearance has grotesquely transformed. Your skin becomes red and leathery, and vicious horns, teeth and nails erupt through the surface of your skin. You can suppress this form and present the appearance of the humanoid you once were, but this is taxing and requires effort. Moments of stress are likely to reveal your true nature. In the following situations your true form may be revealed:

items: Becoming {@condition Bloodied|XPHB}.
{@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on a spell.
Gaining the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition.
Entering hallowed ground.
Entering the presence of Celestials or other Fiends.
Choosing to reveal yourself.

entries: In these events, or times of other extreme emotional or physical stress, a GM can call for a Constitution saving throw with a DC based on your current Transformation Stage. If you fail this save, your Horrific Appearance is revealed.
Non-evil creatures will typically be instantly {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to you, unless the GM decides otherwise.

name: Fiendish Soul
entries: You become a Fiend in addition to any other creature type(s) you have. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks.
Additionally, choose one of the following damage types and gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to it: Acid, Cold, or Fire.

name: Fighter
entries: You gain proficiency with {@filter martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} and training with {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields}. In addition, you gain a {@filter Fighting Style feat|feats|category=FS} of your choice.

name: Final Fzeg Bloodline
entries: You reach the full manifestation of your Fzeg Bloodline. You have the following features:

items: Your Strength score increases by 2 points to a maximum of 20.

The damage done by your Claw attack becomes {@dice 3d6} plus your Strength modifier Slashing damage, using your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} on attack rolls. You can also make three Claw attacks with an {@action Attack|XPHB} action.
You are {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistant} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. Magic and silvered weapons ignore this {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}.
Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

name: Final Soman Bloodline
entries: You reach the full manifestation of your Soman Bloodline. You gain the following features:

items: Your Strength and Dexterity scores increase by 1 to a maximum of 20.
{@optfeature Fanged Bite|GrimHollowPG24|Fanged Bite's} Necrotic damage increases to {@dice 3d8}.

When a Humanoid creature is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by your {@optfeature Fanged Bite|GrimHollowPG24} attack or through your feeding, it rises as a {@creature Vampire Spawn|XMM} 24 hours later unless the body is destroyed or undergoes rituals to prevent its rising. You can have two {@creature Vampire Spawn|XMM|Vampire Spawns} created this way under your control, and they follow your verbal commands to the best of their abilities. If you take control of a third {@creature Vampire Spawn|XMM}, you choose one of the other {@creature Vampire Spawn|XMM} you currently control to no longer follow your commands.

name: Final Strigoi Bloodline
entries: You reach the full manifestation of your Strigoi Bloodline. You have the following features:

items: Your Dexterity score increases by 2 points to a maximum of 20.

You can summon {@dice 2d4} {@creature Swarm of Rats|XMM|Swarms of Rats}, {@creature Swarm of Bats|XMM|Swarms of Bats}, or {@creature Wolf|XMM|Wolves} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. They appear at the start of your next turn within 60 feet of you. They follow your verbal or mental commands. They disperse after 1 hour, when you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or when you dismiss them with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You regain this ability after finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

You can cast the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell up to four times without using a spell slot. You can also cast a spell in this way as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you are targeted with a weapon attack. You cast the spell before taking damage. You regain this ability after finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Find the Thing
entries: As an action, you focus your energy through a navigational object (such as a compass, GPS, or map). Doing so allows you to cast the {@spell Locate Object} spell with the following changes:

items: The spell doesn't require you to concentrate on it.
The spell's duration is 1 hour.
The spell can detect an object within 1 mile of you instead of 1,000 feet.

name: Firm Influence
entries: Others have learned to fear you—and for good reason. You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Terrifying Influence
entries: If you take this trait twice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intimidation checks. You can use this feature a number of times equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: First Age Steed
entries: You enact a ritual that creates a bond with a special vehicle of your choice (such as a bicycle, moped, or similar object you can sit on). This vehicle can only carry one creature, has a walking speed of 60 feet, and does not have a flying speed.
As an action, you can summon that vehicle to your side. While summoned the vehicle is indestructible and disappears in a puff of smoke after 1 hour.

name: First Strike
entries: Hesitation in others is a weakness you've learned to take deadly advantage of. When you hit a creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet, your attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Strong Strike
entries: If you take this trait twice, you can use the maximum value of the extra damage dice from First Strike, rather than rolling. You regain the use of this feature when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Fish
entries: While wearing this mask you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed and the ability to breathe underwater. Additionally, you know the {@spell Water Bullet|ObojimaTallGrass} and {@spell Whelm Weapon|ObojimaTallGrass} spells.

name: Fish Fat Candle
entries: As an action, you can spend 1 wick point to ignite and throw an oily brick of blubber candle wax that lands in an unoccupied space you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you. One round after the candle lands, it emits a cloud of colorful smoke that creates a {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured} area in a 20-foot radius centered on it. The candle continues to spew smoke for 1 minute and creates a visible trail in the sky that can be seen from 10 miles away.

name: Flash of Brimstone
entries: When you place or move a seal, you can activate this boon (no action required) to magically teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of the target.

name: Fleet of Foot
entries: As you've learned more than once, moving fast is often the best way to avoid trouble. Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Shared Fleetness
entries: If you take this trait twice, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by another 5 feet, for a total increase of 10 feet.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose any number of creatures within 30 feet. Those creatures gain a 10 foot bonus to their {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} for 1 minute. You regain the use of this feature when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Fleshknit Phosphate
entries: For 1 minute, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} at the start of each of your turns if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

name: Flight (Celestial, Dragon, Elemental)
entries: For 10 minutes, you grow feathery, feathery, or spectral wings from your back. You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. You can't benefit from this mutation while wearing Heavy Armor.

name: Flooding Abundance
entries: As an action, you can spend 2 wick points to ignite and throw a tea light candle into an unoccupied space you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you. After landing, the candle melts rapidly, bubbling and boiling with an overwhelming amount of wax, which flows over and fills a 15-foot-square centered on the candle. The wax remains for 1 minute. It is flammable, and a 5-foot square of wax exposed to fire burns away in 3 rounds, dealing {@damage 2d6} fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire. All spaces covered in the wax are {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for the duration.

name: Flyer

prerequisite.other: Cicadas, locusts, wasps, or any flying insect

entries: The swarm has a flying speed of 30 feet.

name: Focused Mind
entries: Your strength of will protects you from magic that would corrupt your mind. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Immutable Mind
entries: If you take this trait twice, when you fail a saving throw against being {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to succeed on the save instead. You regain the use of this feature when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Focused Reserves
entries: No matter how badly beaten down you are, you find the will to keep fighting when you most need it. As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} after you take damage, you can roll a number of d6s equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Focused Edge
entries: If you take this trait twice, you can reroll 1s and 2s when you use Focused Reserves, but you must use the new rolls.

name: Foul Interchange
entries: As an action, you choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you and expend a seal to end one of the following conditions afflicting them: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, dazed, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition poisoned}. Another creature you can see within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer that same condition until the end of your next turn. If that creature is immune to the condition, they don't suffer the condition, but the condition ends for the original creature.

name: Fox
entries: While wearing this mask, you can move through a hostile creature's space, regardless of its size, and another creature's space isn't {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for you. Additionally, your AC increases by 1 and when you make a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on the roll.

name: Frayed Thoughts
entries: You suffer the effects of sharing a mind with two personalities. Memories of less practical significance are lost to new ones of midnight hunts. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ability checks and saving throws.

name: Fraying Reality
entries: Your mind begins to slip into the dark places where the world of life and world of death intersect. When you become {@condition Bloodied|XPHB} for the first time after finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you act as though under the effects of a {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell for 1 minute.

name: Friendless

prerequisite.other: Stage 2 of the {@charoption Shadowsteel Ghoul|GrimHollowPG24|Shadowsteel Ghoul Transformation}

entries: You are no longer able to connect with other creatures on a social level. You prefer isolation and twisted contemplation to friendship and camaraderie.
You cannot be considered an ally to any Humanoids or Beasts, and no living creature can be {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} toward you.
You also have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all Charisma ability checks.

name: Fungal Infestation
entries: The underground creature is covered in layers of poisonous fungi. They have immunity to poison damage. The first time the underground creature takes damage on a turn, each creature within 5 feet of them takes {@damage PB} poison damage.

name: Fzeg Bloodline
entries: Your vampirism follows the Fzeg bloodline, a line of vampires that combines the affliction with lycanthropy. You gain the following features:

items: Your Strength score increases by 2. Your Strength score cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

You gain a Claw attack. This attack deals {@dice 1d8} plus your Strength modifier Slashing damage, using your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} on attack rolls. This Claw attack is not a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.
When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make the Claw attack, you may use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a Bite attack from {@optfeature Fanged Bite|GrimHollowPG24}.
Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

name: Ghastly Touch
entries: You can deliver a soul-chilling jolt through your attacks. Once per turn, when you hit a target with a melee attack when you are within 5 feet of the target, you can deal an additional {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage. You regain all uses of this feature when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Giant
entries: You add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to Intelligence and Wisdom checks you make that relate to the Giant creature type. If you are already proficient in a skill when asked to make an Intelligence or Wisdom ability check relating to Giants, you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} instead.
When you gain this feature, you also learn {@language Giant}.

name: Gift of Joyous Life
entries: At the beginning of your turn, if you are {@condition Bloodied|XPHB}, you can choose to roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} (no action required) and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll. If you roll a 1 on this die, you regain no {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and take 1 point of Force damage instead. You regain this ability when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gift of Liberating Freedom
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while aren't wearing Heavy armor, you can manifest a pair of leathery wings. You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. These wings recede if you dismiss them as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn, if you have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, or if you become {@condition Bloodied|XPHB} while they are manifested.

You can have your wing manifested for 1 hour total, including several shorter stints adding up to 1 hour. You regain your ability to use your wings for an hour after finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gift of Martial Prowess
entries: Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can reroll the attack roll. If the reroll hits, you must spend 3 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} and add the result to the attack's normal damage as Force damage. If the reroll misses, you must spend 3 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} and take Psychic damage equal to the result. If you have fewer than 3 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} available, you cannot use this gift.
Once you hit a target with an attack using a rerolled attack, you cannot use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gift of Prodigious Talent
entries: Choose two Skills. Gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in the chosen skills.

If you roll a 1 or 2 on an {@variantrule Ability Check|XPHB} using one of the chosen skills, you immediately lose half your maximum number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, rounded down. You do not regain {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} lost this way until you finish two {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|Long Rests}.

name: Gift of Second Chances
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. If you roll a 2 or better, set your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} total to the result of the roll. If not, you suffer a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} failure. You regain the use of this gift when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gift of Unbridled Power
entries: Upon finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can spend 2 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} and regain a number of spell slot levels equal to the highest number rolled. However, you take Psychic damage equal to twice the total that you rolled. You regain the reuse of this gift when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gift of Unconditional Love
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Transformation Stage. You regain the use of this gift when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
If you roll a 1 on the die, you gain no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and instead have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Gift of Unfettered Glory
entries: Each time you damage a creature with a melee attack, an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, or a cantrip, you can do an additional 2 points Force Damage per Transformation Stage.

Each time you roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you regain 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} fewer per Hit Die.

name: Gift of Unsurpassed Fortune
entries: When an enemy you can see within 10 feet succeeds on an attack roll or a saving throw, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice d20}. On a 6 or higher, the triggering attack or save misses or fails, and you regain the use of your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. Otherwise, you take {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage per Transformation Stage, which cannot be reduced. You regain your use of this ability when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gifted Performer
entries: When you desire to stand out, you have a natural gift for impressing others. You have proficiency in the {@skill Performance|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: A Sight to Behold
entries: If you take this trait twice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Performance checks. You can use this feature a number of times equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Gladiator
entries: This grim metal helm, pockmarked and scratched, conceals the entire face. While you wear this mask, you have proficiency with Martial weapons and training with {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields}. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} to make one attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

name: Glide
entries: The bird can take a short rest while flying horizontally.

name: Goggled Vision
entries: While wearing an ocular covering (such as ski goggles, spectacles, sunglasses, or a welding mask), you can use an action to see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray. Additionally, you have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks to determine if something is an illusion. These effects on your goggles last for 1 hour.

name: Golem
entries: While wearing this mask, your weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d8} damage on a hit. If you are Small, you don't have disadvantage on your attack rolls with weapons as a result of {@itemProperty H||heavy}. In addition, your attacks and spells deal double damage to objects and structures.

name: Grandmother's Curse
entries: You learn one Shadowsteel curse of your choice. You always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. You can cast it once per day without using a spell slot or needing spell components.

name: Grasping Detritus
entries: {@recharge 5} The hag conjures magical seaweed and fish guts to restrain their foes. Each enemy in a 30-foot cone emanating from the hag must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of the hag's next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

name: Grave-Touched Soul
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage. If you already have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage, you gain {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} instead.

name: Gravity Well
entries: When activated, gravity begins accumulating in a {@b 30-foot-radius circle} centred on the trap. The trapped area becomes difficult terrain until the end of the ranger's next turn. Each creature in the area when the trap activates must succeed on a {@b Dexterity saving throw} or be knocked {@condition prone}. Furthermore, each creature in the area that is concentrating must make a {@b Constitution saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature's concentration is broken.
A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@b Strength saving throw} or take {@damage 2d8} force damage and be pulled {@b 15 feet} towards the trap's centre.

At the end of the ranger's next turn, the gravity reaches a critical mass and each creature in the area must make a {@b Strength saving throw}. On a failure, a creature is knocked {@condition prone}, pulled to the trap's centre, and takes {@damage 6d8} force damage. On a success, a creature isn't knocked {@condition prone} or moved, and takes half as much force damage

name: Graying Vision
entries: Your eyes weaken and the world around you begins to lose some of its colorful luster. To adjust to your slowly worsening vision, you've gained {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 15 feet. In addition, you automatically detect visual illusions if their Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check DC is less than or equal to your ranger spell save DC.

name: Grazing Shot
entries: When you miss with a ranged attack roll using a weapon, you can expend one {@classFeature Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die} (no action required) to deal damage to that creature equal to a roll of the die plus your Dexterity modifier (minimum of 1). This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
entries: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can treat any roll of 4 or less on a damage die as a 5. The weapon must have the {@itemProperty 2H||two-handed} or {@itemProperty V||versatile} property for you to gain this benefit.

name: Greater Magic Tricks
entries: Your Fey masters provide even further magical abilities. You gain the ability to cast one level 3 spell, one level 4 spell, and one level 5 spell. You can cast each of these once without using a spell slot or needing spell components. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The DC for these spells is 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage.

entries.name: Spring
entries: Your spells are {@spell Stinking Cloud|XPHB}, {@spell Vitriolic Sphere|XPHB}, and {@spell Cloudkill|XPHB}.

entries.name: Summer
entries: Your spells are {@spell Fireball|XPHB}, {@spell Fire Shield|XPHB}, and {@spell Dream|XPHB}.

entries.name: Autumn
entries: Your spells are {@spell Lightning Bolt|XPHB}, {@spell Blight|XPHB}, and {@spell Hold Monster|XPHB}.

entries.name: Winter
entries: Your spells are {@spell Vampiric Touch|XPHB}, {@spell Ice Storm|XPHB}, and {@spell Cone of Cold|XPHB}.

name: Greater Milestone: Bloodsworn
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Tenacity
entries: You can resist effects that would slow your oath from being carried out. If you begin your turn with the {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition, you may choose to end one of those conditions. Once you use this, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Milestone: Cursemarked
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you lose all prior milestone benefits from this thread and gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Threads Entwined [1–7, Saving Throws, Ability Checks, Attack Rolls]
entries: You can't take {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|Bonus Actions} or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the end of your next turn. When this occurs, another creature of your choice within 30 feet of you can immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Help|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action, or make a single weapon attack against a target in range.

entries.name: Greater Sacrifice
entries: When your Threads Entwined is triggered, you can instead choose to do nothing this turn besides move. If you've already taken your action this turn, you instead forgo your action on your next turn. If you do so, the chosen creature can take one additional action on its next turn, except the {@action Magic|XPHB} action, or it can receive the benefit of one of the previous milestone's Greater Sacrifices. Once you use your Greater Sacrifice, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Milestone: Explorer
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain one of the following benefits.

entries.name: Ennobled
entries: A monarch has recognized your achievements as an Explorer in their or other territories by granting you a noble title, which comes with a moderately sized estate. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks with anyone who would be impressed or intimidated by your title. You also can avoid punishment for minor infractions, though if you abuse this, your title might be revoked.

entries.name: Wayfarer's Steps
entries: You can never become lost by nonmagical means and can always retrace your steps. Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action and command up to 4 willing creatures who can hear you to use their {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to immediately take a {@action Dash|XPHB} action. Neither you nor your allies trigger {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} while moving in this way. Once you use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Milestone: Fatebound
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Doom Delayed
entries: When you would be killed, you may instead declare yourself as {@variantrule Stable|XPHB} with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once you use this, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Knight of Fate
entries: You have become a legend in a territory, and the monarch there has knighted you, granting you holdings that will revert back to the monarchy upon your death. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma-based checks with the people of this land and are frequently showered with minor gifts and favors there.

name: Greater Milestone: Herald
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Persuasive Words
entries: If you make a Charisma check to change a creature's attitude or convince them of your cause, you may treat a roll of 9 or lower on the {@dice d20} as a 10. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Milestone: Legend Hunter
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Finish the Fight
entries: When you cause a creature to become {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, your next attack that hits it becomes a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. Once you use this, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Milestone: Sworn Huskarl
entries: When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Undying Loyalty
entries: The strength of your oath steels you when the tides of battle turn against you. When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can use this to instead set your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to be equal to your character level. This doesn't help you against an effect that would kill you instantly without dealing damage. Once you use this, you can't use it again for 7 days.

name: Greater Sanguine Curse
entries: Your curse has taken a stronger hold onto you. You gain the following features:

items: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} when you are in sunlight.
You must feed every 4 days.

name: Hag Form
entries: Your {@variantrule Creature Type|XPHB} becomes Fey in addition to any other creature type(s) you have.

Additionally, your connection with the magic of the natural world provides you with increased defenses. When you are not wearing armor, your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 13 plus your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, choose Strength, Intelligence, or Charisma: you are proficient with Saving Throws using that ability score.

name: Hardened Defense (Armor Modification)
entries: Hardened scales or magical pelts make your armor difficult to pierce. While wearing your crafted armor, you gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

name: Harpy
entries: While wearing this mask you have a flying speed of 30 feet and resistance to psychic damage.

name: Haunting Flight
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

Also, while you are flying, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to focus your terrifying presence on one creature you can see within 30 feet. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The DC for the Wisdom saving throw is 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Transformation Stage. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

name: Healing Resistance

prerequisite.other: Stage 3 of the {@charoption Shadowsteel Ghoul|GrimHollowPG24|Shadowsteel Ghoul Transformation}

entries: You heal at a slower rate than normal, whether that healing is magical or natural. Whenever you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you regain half as many {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} as you should. You still recover all {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Hear the Unseen
entries: At the start of their turn, the cave creature can emit a subsonic trill (no action required).
